name: Greenhouse Job Board
tagline: Public job board API for careers pages and open roles
description: Greenhouse Job Board is a public, read-only REST API that exposes a company's open jobs, job details, departments, offices, and application form fields for careers-page and recruiting integrations. It is widely used by companies that run Greenhouse ATS to power custom job listings without a private Harvest API key. Endpoints are unauthenticated for public boards and return JSON suitable for embedding listings, building job widgets, and submitting applications.

auth.details: Public Job Board API requires no API key for standard board endpoints; access is by board token in the path (e.g. /v1/boards/{board_token}/jobs). Some write/application flows may differ—verify docs.

use_cases: list open jobs for a company's Greenhouse board
fetch full job description and location by job id
get departments and offices for a careers page
read application form fields for a job
submit a job application to a Greenhouse board
